name: MIS Webform
author: mistechnolabs

sections.description:
MIS Webform is a full-featured form builder for WordPress. Create contact forms, surveys,
registration forms, and multi-step forms in minutes. No coding needed, and no limit on forms or
submissions.

Features

  • Drag-and-drop form builder with 38+ field types
  • 8 ready-made templates: contact, donation, membership, course enrollment, event RSVP, file
    upload, poll, and survey
  • Multi-step forms with a progress bar
  • Conditional logic: show or hide fields based on the visitor’s answers
  • File uploads: images, documents, audio, and video, with file type and size limits
  • Signature field: visitors sign with their mouse or finger
  • Form validation: required fields, length limits, and custom error messages
  • Email notifications to you, plus an optional copy to the visitor
  • Spam protection: honeypot, Google reCAPTCHA, and submission rate limiting
  • Form block for the WordPress block editor, plus a shortcode for any page
  • Live preview of your form before you publish it
  • Submissions inbox with unread markers, file downloads, and CSV export
  • Form analytics dashboard: views, submissions, and conversion rate for the last 7 days
  • Google Sheets sync: send every new submission to a Google spreadsheet automatically
  • Privacy friendly: works with the WordPress personal data export and erase tools

Field types

Text, email, phone, number, website, date, time, dropdown, multi-select, radio buttons,
checkboxes, toggle, name, address, country, star rating, slider, Likert scale, color picker,
signature, terms and conditions, hidden field, file upload, page break, and more.

External services

This plugin can connect to two Google services. Both are off by default and only work after you
set them up.

Google reCAPTCHA (optional spam protection for a form)

  • Sends: the visitor’s reCAPTCHA answer and IP address to Google, when they submit a form that has
    reCAPTCHA turned on. The reCAPTCHA script is loaded from https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js
    and the answer is checked at https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify.
  • When: only on forms where you turned reCAPTCHA on and added your own keys.
  • Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

Google Sheets (optional, MIS Webform → Google Sheets)

  • Sends: your service account sign-in to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token, and the form
    answers you chose to https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/. These answers can include
    personal data the visitor entered.
  • When: only after you connect a Google account and turn on a feed for a form.
  • Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Google APIs Terms

Nothing else is sent anywhere. All other files are bundled with the plugin.

Credits

Date and time picker: flatpickr 4.6.13 (MIT license).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New, search for MIS Webform, then install and activate it.
  2. Go to MIS Webform → New Form and build your form, or pick a template.
  3. Add the form to a page with the MIS Webform block, or paste its shortcode, for example
    [mis-webform id=”1″].
sections.faq:
How do I add a form to a page?

In the block editor, click +, search for MIS Webform, and choose your form. In other editors,
paste the form’s shortcode, for example [mis-webform id="1"].

Where can I see the submissions?

Go to MIS Webform → Submissions. You can read them, download uploaded files, delete them, and
export them to CSV.

How do I send submissions to Google Sheets?

  1. Go to MIS Webform → Google Sheets and add your Google service account key. The page shows
    step-by-step how to get one.
  2. Share your spreadsheet with the service account email as an Editor.
  3. Create a feed: choose a form and a spreadsheet, then save.

Each new submission is then added as a new row. The free version connects each form to one
spreadsheet.

What is the signature field?

It lets visitors sign your form with their mouse or finger, like signing on paper. The signature is
saved as an image with the submission.

What does the dashboard show?

How many people viewed each form, how many submitted it, and the conversion rate, for the last 7
days. No personal visitor data is stored for this.

Are uploaded files safe?

Yes. Uploaded files are stored in a protected folder with random names, and only administrators can
download them. On Nginx servers, add this rule:
location ^~ /wp-content/uploads/mis-webform-private/ { deny all; }

My site uses Cloudflare. Why do all submissions show the same IP?

Go to MIS Webform → Settings → Visitor IP address and choose Cloudflare.

Will I lose my forms if I delete the plugin?

No. Your forms and submissions are kept unless you turn on Data on uninstall in
MIS Webform → Settings before deleting the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • New: Dynamic tags for Hidden Fields, filled in when the form is sent: UTM parameters, any URL parameter, page and post details, custom fields, site and logged-in user details, submission date and time, and WooCommerce product details.
  • New: Number and Range Slider fields have Minimum, Maximum, and Step settings.
  • New: Terms of Service fields have settings for the terms text and the agreement text.
  • Improved: Each field shows only the settings that apply to it.
  • Improved: The Pattern setting has one-click examples and a live test box, and warns when a pattern can’t work.
  • Improved: Email (with Confirm) shows its two boxes as one field, checks that they match while the visitor types, and shows the mismatch message under the second box.
  • Improved: The conditional logic field list shows only fields that can be used in a condition.
  • Improved: Column Layout is replaced by each field’s Width setting.
  • Fixed: When a field has no Field Key, the builder now highlights that field and names it, instead of showing an unclear error.
  • Fixed: Single checkbox now shows its “Checkbox Label” text next to the box.
  • Fixed: Custom error messages now show for every field type, including checkboxes, toggles, choices, and file uploads.
  • Fixed: A required Toggle must now be switched on before the form can be sent.
  • Fixed: The Textarea character and word counter now works, and Textarea length and pattern rules are checked.
  • Fixed: Minimum and maximum dates and times are now checked when the form is sent, and Date & Time respects its time limits.
  • Fixed: Range Slider fields no longer show empty labels.
  • Fixed: Fields set to Half, One-third, or One-quarter width now sit side by side.
  • Fixed: The character counter resets after a form is sent.
  • Fixed: An error message on a field with several parts (such as Select with Other) no longer disappears.
  • Fixed: Star rating fields now show their stars. Choose 3 to 10 stars and the icon (stars, hearts, dots, or thumbs up).
  • Fixed: Dropdowns now start on “Select an option”, so a required dropdown needs a real choice.
  • Fixed: Select, Radios, and Checkboxes with “Other” now come with options.
  • Fixed: Required choices, checkboxes, terms, ratings, signatures, and file uploads are now checked before Next and Submit.
  • Fixed: Number and slider fields accept only numbers.
  • Fixed: “Other” answers now show clearly on the submission screen.
  • Fixed: Country, file upload, and HTML fields can now use conditional logic.

1.0.2

  • New: Form block for the WordPress block editor.
  • New: Form analytics dashboard with views, submissions, and conversion rate.
  • New: Google Sheets sync for form submissions.
  • New: Live preview of forms in a new tab.
  • New: Save and Preview buttons stay visible while you edit a form. Press Ctrl+S to save.
  • New: Cloudflare and proxy support for the visitor IP address.
  • Improved: New design for the Submissions and Settings pages.
  • Improved: Likert scale fields now show as a rating scale.
  • Fixed: Forms with hidden required fields can now be submitted.
  • Fixed: Name, address, and “Other” answers are now saved.
  • Fixed: Multiple file uploads now keep every file.
  • Fixed: File links in notification emails now open.
  • Fixed: reCAPTCHA now works when the form is submitted a second time.
  • Fixed: File uploads on Windows servers.
  • Fixed: Uploaded files are now deleted together with their submission.
  • Security: Stronger protection for uploaded files and email notifications.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Database tables now install on all MySQL and MariaDB versions.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
